LOOK_AT_TARGET.control: HEAD_MOVEMENT additive tilt + small weight shift

rules.channels: body (pose layers, contacts, hand switches) and face (FUTURE_FACIAL_CONTROLS) are separate; a face tracker can never move a body channel
rules.priority: live input > artist keys > procedural gesture clips > idle; contacts outrank gestures on their chain
rules.ik: contacts are applied after every pose layer, so a live gesture cannot pull a planted hand off
rules.secondary: live: secondary motion is off or uses the fixed-step spring with a short reset; it never depends on playback history
rules.neutral: RETURN_TO_IDLE blends every layer back to the base pose with C2 ramps
rules.smoothing: optional critically damped smoothing of live inputs (time constant set per control)
rules.hand_switches: triggered switches respect the 0.25 s minimum hold
rules.inference: no cloud or AI inference during live animation: every control is a lookup or a closed-form solve
